title: Director of Business Operations
description:
Details of the role

  • Location: Remote (preference for UTC-6 to UTC+5).

  • Type of work: Full-time (contractor or employee depending on circumstances).

  • Level: IC5 Staff and above.

  • We're a remote company, operating mostly asynchronously.

The company

MUI's story began in 2014 with Material UI, the most successful React implementation of Google's Material Design. This open-source project has paved the way for the fully-fledged startup known as MUI (founded in 2019), which now boasts an ever-expanding ecosystem of React UI products. We're a company of 40 people as of 2026, and we're growing steadily.

The products

MUI is best known for our flagship product, Material UI—but this is just one of the UI libraries we maintain. Material UI is complemented by advanced components through MUI X (Data Grid, Charts, Date and Time Pickers, Tree View) for more complex user interactions and data visualization needs. Base UI is our headless component library. We also host Design Kits and pre-built Templates.

The culture

MUI is a fully remote company with a team that spans the globe. The majority of our work is asynchronous, and we rely on written communication to collaborate. We're radically transparent: a lot of our work happens in public. Each contributor has the freedom to decide how and when they work, and that work is primarily self-directed: it's your responsibility to define and complete your own tasks in a timely manner.

For additional details about the culture, you can check our careers and about pages and also our public Handbook.

Why we're hiring

As MUI scales past 40 people, our biggest bottleneck is increasingly execution in business operations. Without a dedicated business operations leader, executive bandwidth gets tied up in day-to-day tasks rather than high-leverage decisions, critical cross-functional projects stall between departments, etc.

We are hiring a Director of Business Operations to offload executive operations from the CEO and build the machinery required for our products to reach their full potential. In this role, you will take on critical initiatives, ensure that cross-functional friction is resolved, and enforce a high bar of execution across the entire business.

Overall, both our open-source community and our premium products are growing fast. We need talented people to keep up with the demands of our exigent community!

Why this is interesting

You will operate at the intersection of business, revenue, system design (for example, AI), strategy, and organization design. You won't manage processes—you will lead a team that builds scalable foundations, untangles complex cross-functional friction (across Finance, Marketing, Product, Sales, People, Finance, and Engineering), and incubates new capabilities (like RevOps or internal tooling migrations) from 0 to 1.

If you love first-principles problem-solving, data, obsessing over operational details, and building living systems that save organization-wide time at scale, this role offers large autonomy and high strategic leverage. We care deeply about precision, excellence, and deep focus on the inputs (not the outputs): "How you do anything is how you do everything."

Our products empower React developers to build awesome applications faster – we see millions of developers on MUI's docs every year, one million a month.

The role

Key responsibilities

Depending on the day, you'll:

  • Track performance & resolve bottlenecks: Monitor company KPIs, detect operational risks early, and deploy targeted interventions to solve root causes across departments.

  • Lead operational scaling & systems design: Build, optimize, and automate scalable workflows, OKR cadences, and operating systems. Manage the Operations Engineer and temporarily own critical functions like interim RevOps.

  • Lead people: Manage a team of operational contributors (including an operations engineer, people partner, operations manager), unblocking their daily work and setting clear execution standards.

  • Drive special projects (0-to-1): Lead high-priority strategic experiments, expansions, or internal turnarounds from inception through execution to smooth handoff.

  • Break down cross-functional silos: Facilitate seamless collaboration across Product, Sales, Engineering, and Finance to eliminate friction and increase decision-making velocity.

  • Act as an executive proxy & advisor: Partner directly with the CEO and leadership team to offload executive initiatives, align company scorecards, and run core operating forums.

Overall, expect the role to be 60% execution, 40% team management.

Who we're looking for

Required

  • High-agency & cross-functional judgment: Self-directed problem solver who thrives in ambiguity and can prioritize among many opportunities. See Manager of one.

  • High conscientiousness & detail rigor: Strong commitment to eventually reach no-defect execution; double-checks everything, maintains clean documentation, focuses on friction-free user experiences.

  • Executive presence & business acumen: Sound financial judgment, strong understanding of unit economics/gross margins, and the communication skills required to align senior leaders without direct line authority.

  • First-principles analytical rigor: Proven track record of breaking down complex, ambiguous operational problems into root causes rather than treating superficial symptoms.

  • Hands-on data literacy & systems design: Strong experience designing metrics, operating cadences (OKRs, WBRs/QBRs), and working alongside data/analytics engineers or tool stacks to establish single sources of truth.

  • Strategic execution & ownership: Demonstrated success leading cross-functional strategic projects from scratch to a stable handoff, or taking on interim functional lead roles.

  • Relentless drive for excellence: Follow the Boy Scout philosophy. You naturally leave every document, system, or workflow in better shape than you found it, proactively paying down operational debt.

Nice to have (but not required)

  • Former founder, Chief of Staff, or operations lead experience at a scaling startup (40–100 employees).

  • Hands-on experience with modern analytics stacks (for example, SQL, Python).

  • Prior experience in a developer tools or open-core business.

Benefits and compensation

We offer competitive compensation commensurate with your experience level and location and are prepared to pay top market rates for someone who can clearly exceed the role's expectations. You can find the other perks and benefits on the careers page.

Don't meet every requirement? Apply anyway! Research shows that certain folks are less likely to apply for a role than others unless they meet 100% of the outlined qualifications. If this role excites you, we want to hear from you. We'd love for you to share the unique skills, passion, and experience you could bring to MUI.

title: Operations Engineer
description:
Details of the role

  • Location: Remote (preference for UTC-6 to UTC+5).

  • Type of work: Full-time (contractor or employee depending on circumstances).

  • Level: IC4 Senior and above.

  • We're a remote company, operating mostly asynchronously.

The company

MUI's story began in 2014 with Material UI, the most successful React implementation of Google's Material Design. This open-source project has paved the way for the fully-fledged startup known as MUI (founded in 2019), which now boasts an ever-expanding ecosystem of React UI products. We're a company of 40 people as of 2026, and we're growing steadily.

The products

MUI is best known for our flagship product, Material UI—but this is just one of the UI libraries we maintain. Material UI is complemented by advanced components through MUI X (Data Grid, Charts, Date and Time Pickers, Tree View) for more complex user interactions and data visualization needs. Base UI is our headless component library. We also host Design Kits and pre-built Templates.

The culture

MUI is a fully remote company with a team that spans the globe. The majority of our work is asynchronous, and we rely on written communication to collaborate. We're radically transparent: a lot of our work happens in public. Each contributor has the freedom to decide how and when they work, and that work is primarily self-directed: it's your responsibility to define and complete your own tasks in a timely manner.

For additional details about the culture, you can check our careers and about pages and also our public Handbook.

Why we're hiring

MUI is scaling, but traditional business operations have become a strong bottleneck to our growth. The leadership team is spending too much time on manual, repetitive tasks, building spreadsheets, debugging ETL regressions, wiring SaaS tools together, firefighting operational issues, etc.

Rather than hiring a conventional IT team, we treat internal company operations as an engineering problem. We believe that applying systems thinking, modern software engineering, and AI automation directly to business operations will create immense leverage.

We are opening this role to act as a hands-on force multiplier across the organization—building zero-defect data models, automated internal tools, and AI-driven workflows across Finance, GTM (RevOps, Sales, Marketing), People, and Product.

Overall, both our open-source community and our premium products are growing fast. We need talented people to keep up with the demands of our exigent community!

Why this is interesting

  • Function as a modern hands-on CIO / Head of business systems: Instead of managing large corporate budgets or enterprise governance, you will directly apply software engineering (TypeScript, SQL, AI frameworks) to real-world business systems.

  • Massive organizational leverage: You will step into cross-functional gaps to eliminate operational bottlenecks, saving hundreds of hours of leadership time and accelerating company velocity.

  • High-agency autonomy: Operating without a rigid backlog, you will systematically map MUI's cross-functional workflows using Lean principles, identify high-leverage opportunities, and build end-to-end technical solutions.

  • AI-first execution: You will be at the forefront of implementing AI agents, LLM tool integrations, and low-code orchestration engines to automate routine business tasks across every department.

Our products empower React developers to build awesome applications faster – we see millions of developers on MUI's docs every year, one million a month.

The role

Key responsibilities

Depending on the day, you'll:

  • Internal systems architecture & management (Modern IT/CIO): Own, maintain, and connect the company's internal software stack—from CRM, billing, and Accounting platforms to internal databases and analytics dashboards.

  • AI & workflow automation engine: Identify, prototype, and build custom scripts (SQL, JavaScript), AI agents, low-code integrations (for example, Zapier, Make), etc. to eliminate manual tasks across People, Finance, Sales, Marketing, Product, and Operations.

  • GTM & RevOps technical execution: Partner with Sales and Marketing to streamline lead pipelines, customer data enrichment, conversion funnels, and customer-facing website updates.

  • Data Engineering & Operational analytics: Build and maintain data pipelines, operational dashboards, and data models to power strategic decision-making (for example, pricing model LTV analysis, product adoption telemetry, sales PO volumes, npm/GitHub ecosystem metrics, or OKRs progress).

  • Process engineering & Systems optimization: Apply the five core Lean principles and systems analysis to map company workflows, identify operational or financial bottlenecks, and build technological solutions to resolve them.

  • Technical force multiplier for Leadership: Serve as a direct execution arm for executive leadership—stepping in to resolve unowned, cross-cutting technical issues across products, vendor platforms, or internal operations.

Who we're looking for

Required

  • High-agency & Cross-functional judgment: Self-directed problem solver who thrives in ambiguity and can prioritize among many opportunities. See Manager of one.

  • High conscientiousness & Detail rigor: Strong commitment to eventually reach no-defect execution; double-checks everything, maintains immaculate documentation, focuses on friction-free user experiences.

  • Modern business Tech Stack management (CIO/RevOps): Technical mastery over core SaaS ecosystems (Salesforce/HubSpot, Stripe, NetSuite/Xero, Segment, GitHub/npm APIs).

  • Full-Stack engineering: Proficiency in TypeScript and SQL; can quickly build internal tools, scripts, and API integrations.

  • Systems & Process engineering (Lean/Systems thinking): Ability to map cross-functional workflows, spot operational bottlenecks, and apply Lean principles to eliminate non-value-added steps.

  • Data engineering & Analytics architecture: Track record of designing reliable data pipelines, maintaining zero-defect data models, and delivering actionable BI dashboards (Revenue, LTV, PLG telemetry). For example, ensures data & financial models match to the cent.

  • Workflow automation & AI agents: Hands-on experience with modern AI workflows (LLM APIs, agentic frameworks, function calling) alongside low-code orchestration engines (for example, Pipedream, Make, Zapier, n8n).

  • 4+ years of professional software engineering experience, with at least 2+ years spent building internal tools, data pipelines, or cross-functional business automation.

Nice to have (but not required)

  • Prior experience as an early-stage startup founder, Technical Operations Lead, GTM Engineer, Finance Ops Engineer, or Principal Engineer with cross-functional scope.

  • Experience with React, Next.js, and MUI's tool ecosystem.

  • Deep familiarity with open-source ecosystems, developer tools, or PLG (Product-Led Growth) telemetry metrics.

  • Background in applying Lean principles within knowledge work or software development contexts.

Benefits and compensation

We offer competitive compensation commensurate with your experience level and location and are prepared to pay top market rates for someone who can clearly exceed the role's expectations. You can find the other perks and benefits on the careers page.

Don't meet every requirement? Apply anyway! Research shows that certain folks are less likely to apply for a role than others unless they meet 100% of the outlined qualifications. If this role excites you, we want to hear from you. We'd love for you to share the unique skills, passion, and experience you could bring to MUI.
